speaker: Mr Yip Hon Weng
text: asked the Minister for Health (a) whether there have been any reports of the use of nasal inhalers or “energy sticks” in Singapore, especially amongst children and students; and (b) whether the Ministry has studied (i) the effects of such inhalers and (ii) the need to treat them like vaporisers and e-cigarettes.

speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
text: They contain ingredients that are similar to the conventional nasal decongestant inhaler.
